description: Source code for an Odoo module implementing a dashboard with customizable views, lines, and notes.

classes.name: board_board
classes.description: Represents a customizable dashboard with view creation and update capabilities.

classes.name: board_line
classes.description: Represents individual action views within the dashboard.

classes.name: board_note_type
classes.description: Defines types of notes that can be attached to the dashboard.

classes.name: board_note
classes.description: Represents notes associated with the dashboard, including subject, content, author, and date.

methods.name: create_view
methods.description: Generates XML architecture for the dashboard view based on line configurations.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Overrides write method to update the view architecture after changes.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new dashboard and its associated view.

methods.name: fields_view_get
methods.description: Retrieves and possibly customizes the view architecture.
